product_one_liner.value: Qubrid provides a unified platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises to build, deploy, manage, and scale AI/ML workloads.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product, workflow, and general AI/GPU guidance, but not two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product and developer articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists a Full Stack AI Engineer role.

model_provider.value: Qubrid says it supports 30+ open-source models, including LLaMA, Mistral, CodeLlama, and Stable Diffusion; it does not identify one exclusive underlying model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Qubrid claims SOC 2 compliance; its enterprise page describes its GPU infrastructure as deployed in SOC 2- and HIPAA-compliant data centers.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists the June 2024 angel round as completed; its later $25M seed entry is marked upcoming, not completed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed completed funding is the June 2024 angel round, before the 18-month window; the later seed entry is marked upcoming.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists engineering roles, not SDR, BDR, or account executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: Qubrid announced GPU Cloud Platform V3 on 2026-10-07, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The located CTO appointment announcement is dated April 2024, outside the requested window; available sources do not provide a complete, checkable roster or enough evidence to verify other C-level/VP changes.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A job listing says to maintain and update the CRM (HubSpot/Zoho).
